observations: Photo 0: front of a black DSLR body reading 'Canon', 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II', body cap fitted, no lens.
Photo 1: rear of the body with the screen off, eyecup present, buttons and rear dial intact, no visible cracks.
Photo 2: underside plate reading 'Canon DS126201, DC 8.1V, Made in Japan' with serial number 3761814763; battery door is open and no battery is shown.
All three are studio shots on a plain white background with a 'Posted on Jiji Cdicson Business World' watermark.
No lens, battery, charger, powered-on screen or shutter count screenshot appears in any photo.

claims.claim: Canon EOS 5D Mark II full frame, 21.1 megapixel
claims.evidence: Photo 0 badge reads EOS 5D Mark II and photo 2 plate reads DS126201.
No shutter count screenshot from a test photo.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens appears in any photo; only a body cap is shown, so it is priced as body only.
Photo 2 shows the battery door open with no battery in view; no charger shown.
Repair history cannot be seen in photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, shoot, or show an image on the rear screen.
risks.proof: Clip of the camera powering on, taking a shot and playing it back on the rear screen.

risks.risk: High shutter count on an old body.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from a fresh test photo, with the serial 3761814763 matched.

risks.risk: Battery and charger missing or non original.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery fitted and the charger with labels readable.
risks.if_unproven: as body only with no battery or charger

risks.risk: Clean studio photos may not be the seller's own unit; sensor, mirror and mount condition unseen.
risks.proof: Photo of the open mount showing mirror and sensor, beside a handwritten code with the seller's name and date.
risks.if_unproven: as the worst condition consistent with the photos

risks.proof: Photo of the lens with its name ring readable, and a photo through it against a light.

proof_requests: Clip powering on, shooting and playing back an image
Shutter count screenshot from a fresh test photo
Photo of the body with a handwritten code in shot and the mount open
Photo of any lens included, with its name readable
response.reason: The badge and underside plate identify a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested body only with no battery, charger or lens. Function, shutter count and accessory proof would raise it.
